summary: Final HEAD 9be369d82332a4764b3462053f584522e6d8d706 is spec-consistent for the owner-resolution surface: Story, architecture, code, and verification evidence now agree that Mission Control must show human-readable owner_resolution labels, including the final partial-match and generic-owner cases.
inspection_summary: Inspected the review request, story and architecture docs, responsibility SSOT, PR traceability/evidence artifacts, workflow owner-resolution logic in server/services/workflow/workflow-service.js, Mission Control rendering in public/workflows.html, the exact HEAD diff, and the updated unit/E2E evidence covering unique_partial_name_or_alias and generic_owner_hint_requires_human_selection label rendering.
judgment_delta: The only material spec-consistency risk at this layer was raw owner_resolution reason keys leaking into Mission Control for cases the architecture expects operators to read as workflow guidance; the reviewed HEAD resolves that by adding the two missing UI label mappings and by extending the Playwright surface check to require friendly labels while forbidding the raw keys.
